verdict.rationale: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is a law firm offering legal advisory services, so an interactive API reference with runnable examples is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm ships a public API or developer docs. Its legaltech adoption and the Prarambh incubator are internal and advisory programs, not a developer-facing product.
